points.quote: Declare the identifier with the same name as the interface: `export const IFooService = createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')`.
constructor(@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService) { super(); }
The class must be created through the instantiation service, not with a bare `new`: `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, ...nonServiceArgs)`
